6820.title: Completion excerpts cross child-turn boundaries
6820.rootCauseOneLine: Child completion excerpts use the latest non-empty output of the entire thread rather than the completed root turn.

prReviews.verdict: Static root-cause approach supported; closed unmerged
prReviews.topFinding: Turn-specific lookup addresses the defect; outputless-notice suppression is broader than required and was not executed.

6820.proposedFix: Carry the completed turn ID and scope its root-agent output query while retaining status-only notices and the existing thread output route.
6820.caveats: Same-agent second clean reproduction. No live provider or desktop; extra parent turns not established. Regression patch is inline under report-repository policy.
